subject: Service recovery, timeline, and customer playbook for last week's latency spike
summary: Customer-facing post-incident package for Folio.ai: concise RCA, timeline, immediate mitigations, and a short operational playbook for future recovery
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@folio.ai>, ops@folio.ai
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brief update: service recovery & next steps

Hi Liam / Folio ops team,

Quick update from Redwood: we completed the immediate remediation last night and the production inference fleet has been stable for ~18 hours. You should no longer see the elevated 99th percentile latency for your high-concurrency jobs.

We're compiling a short customer-facing package that includes:
- A concise RCA summary and timeline
- Impact numbers (requests affected, percent of jobs retried)
- The mitigations we applied and long-term fixes in flight
- An ops playbook for faster recovery if a similar failure recurs

Can you confirm the list of people you want copied on the final package? We'll attach the full RCA PDF and a short runbook.

Thanks again for your patience — I’ll send the package by EOD.

— Ava Chen
Account Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@folio.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, ops@folio.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 09:34:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Brief update: service recovery & next steps

Thanks Ava — appreciate the quick update. Please include: myself (liam@folio.ai), Nora Patel (nora@folio.ai), and our platform lead (platform-lead@folio.ai).

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@folio.ai>, ops@folio.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 10:04:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Brief update: service recovery & next steps

Adding our incident engineering notes to the thread. We'll include impact counts and a short timeline. Early summary (high level):
- Trigger: automated kernel selection path mis-evaluated a newly deployed quantized model variant under a specific token-length distribution; this caused degraded batching behavior and increased tail latency for a subset of requests.
- Scope: ~2.1% of Folio inference requests during the 03:50–05:20 UTC window experienced increased 99p latency and ~0.6% were retried by client-side logic. No data corruption observed.
- Immediate mitigation: rolled back the model variant and pinned kernel selection to the previous stable profile; scaled dedicated nodes to absorb bursts.

I will prepare the technical timeline and drop it in the package. Ava — plan to send the customer-facing RCA and the ops playbook; Stephanie can finalize the PDF.

— Markus (Engineering lead, runtime)
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@folio.ai>, Nora Patel <nora@folio.ai>, platform-lead@folio.ai
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 13:18:22 -07:00
Subject: Draft timeline & immediate action items (for review)

Hi Liam / Nora / platform team —

Below is a concise timeline we plan to include in the RCA PDF. Please flag any questions.

Timeline (UTC):
- 2026-04-25 03:47 UTC — Scheduled model variant deploy begins in canary.
- 2026-04-25 04:10 UTC — Canary telemetry shows increased per-token latency for longer inputs; autoscaling did not trigger immediately due to conservative burst thresholds.
- 2026-04-25 04:45 UTC — Canary -> staged rollout proceeds; a small fraction of production traffic receives the new kernel profile.
- 2026-04-25 03:50–05:20 UTC — Observable increase in 99p latency for affected requests; Folio reported automated retries and queueing backoff from their agent.
- 2026-04-25 05:25 UTC — We halted staged rollout and rolled back the variant; pinned kernel selection to stable profile.
- 2026-04-25 06:00 UTC — Latency returned to baseline and autoscaling cleared intermediate queues.

Immediate actions taken (already completed):
- Rollback of model variant and pinning to stable kernel profile.
- Temporary adjustment of burst autoscaling thresholds for Folio's cluster to reduce retry cascades.
- Collection of trace logs and wasm execution traces (attached excerpt).

Proposed next steps (short timeline):
- 1 week: Deliver formal RCA PDF and ops playbook.
- 2 weeks: Release a patch to the kernel-selector to add an explicit validation gate for quantized variants.
- 6 weeks: Release automated canary validation checks and expanded telemetry for token-length distributions.

Please let me know if you'd like this in a different format. We'll send the formal RCA + playbook as a PDF with a one-page executive summary.

— Ava
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@folio.ai>, Nora Patel <nora@folio.ai>, platform-lead@folio.ai
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Folio.ai RCA, timeline, and short ops playbook (attached)

Hi Liam / Nora / platform team —

Attached is the final customer-facing RCA for the 2026-04-25 latency spike, plus a two-page ops playbook with immediate checks and recommended run commands your SREs can use during a recurrence. Key points at a glance:

Executive summary:
- Root cause: The kernel-selection microservice incorrectly selected a new execution kernel profile for a quantized model variant when presented with a specific input token-length distribution; the profile produced worse batching characteristics and increased 99p latency for longer sequences.
- Impact: Approximately 2.1% of production requests for Folio were affected during the 03:50–05:20 UTC window on 2026-04-25. About 0.6% of those requests triggered client-side retries; we observed no data integrity loss.
- Mitigation & status: Immediate rollback and kernel pinning completed 04:25 UTC; system baseline restored by 06:00 UTC. Long-term mitigations in progress: validation gate for kernel selection, expanded telemetry, and safer canary rollout logic.

Attachments included:
- RCA_Folio_20260430.pdf (full RCA + exec summary)
- wasm-tracing-log-04-25.txt (trace excerpt)

Short ops playbook (summary):
1) If you observe elevated 99p latency: verify model variant id and kernel profile via our admin endpoint (/admin/models).
2) If retries cascade, temporarily increase client retry-backoff and open a ticket with Redwood with trace ids.
3) Run the provided healthcheck script (link in the PDF) to validate KV-cache priming and batch sizes.

Next actions from Redwood (owner):
- Stephanie: deliver detailed RCA (done) and host 30-minute technical review with Folio SREs next week.
- Markus: deliver kernel-selector patch PR within 2 weeks.
- Ava: follow up on contractual remediation credits (if any) after your review.

Happy to jump on a call to walk through the RCA in detail. Thanks for the partnership and patience here.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: RCA_Folio_20260430.pdf (application/pdf), wasm-tracing-log-04-25.txt (text/plain)]
